methods.what: Correction to reduce from the Paris to the Göttingen meridian
Assumed constants for the tables: epoch 1800, yearly and four-Julian-year changes, daily motion, perihelion, eccentricity
Expression for M via the AGM m of A and c=sqrt(A^2-B^2) and a logarithmic series
Weighted sum of squares of the AGM differences related to m and M
Perimeter of an ellipse with semiaxes A, B via the AGM and a logarithmic series
